evidence.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels

summary: Researchers distinguish between three levels of evaluation—action, task, and step—for assessing AI coding agents, providing clarity on how to measure their performance. The findings aim to standardize benchmarks in the rapidly evolving field of AI-assisted programming.
title: Study Clarifies Evaluation Metrics for AI Coding Agents: Action, Task, and Step Levels Defined
